_comment: Query support indexes for GameBase tables. Single source for the app (src-tauri/src/database.rs) and the Node scripts (scripts/sqlite_support_config.js). Changing this list requires bumping SCHEMA_VERSION in database.rs. Do not add single-column platform_id indexes on Games: almost every game in a library shares one platform_id, and without ANALYZE statistics SQLite then joins GameView through that index and library queries become quadratic.

indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_games_ga_id ON Games(GA_Id)
